functional_requirements.statement: The system shall let a registered member set a new password by redeeming a single-use reset token emailed to the account address, which expires 30 minutes after it is issued.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a registered member who forgot their password, when a reset is requested, then a single-use link is emailed to the account address.
Given a reset token issued less than 30 minutes ago and not yet used, when a new password is submitted with it, then the password is changed and the token is spent.
Given a reset token that has expired or was already used, when a new password is submitted with it, then the request is rejected and the stored password is unchanged.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall email a single-use reset link to the address of a registered member who requests a password reset.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a registered member, when a reset is requested for their account, then an email with a single-use link is sent to the account address.
Given an address that belongs to no account, when a reset is requested, then the response is identical and no email is sent.
